name: With a two-piece washable rug: Tumble's Amara Light Blue/Ivory 5x7 from Amazon, pad included, on the play floor
notes: Andrew, 2026-10-26 (night): "I think we need something like a ruggable so that it's thin enough and separate from the padding to allow actually washing." Layout G with the two-piece system in place of the one-piece SAFAVIEH: Tumble's Amara Light Blue/Ivory 5x7 ($199, cushioned pad included), a medallion with ivory and white and pops of forest green and golden yellow. 5x7 is the size between Tumble's 3x5 and 6x9, 8" wider and 12" longer than the SAFAVIEH: x 40 to 100, y 37 to 121 (rot 0), 12" off the heater (F-33), its left 19" under the TROFAST's edge, 3" short of the step wall, clear of the door's landing; it lies in the closet's landing, which a rug may do (F-42). Color (F-68): the one cool color her white, green and flowered room lacks, light enough to read pale on the oak, the green pops tying to the FLISAT and the LÖVA. The staged A stays rugless until Eutine chooses. Andrew, later that night: "tumble rug is orderable on amazon! pretty convenient we should prefer that unless ruggable is way better or something": the rug placed is the Amazon listing amazon-B0HCN45T37 ($199, ships in 4 to 5 days, free delivery November 9, as read 2026-10-26), the same set at the same price; Ruggable's flatwoven is judged not clearly better (thinner cover, $180 more per 8x10, made to order, the same robot-vacuum caveat), so Tumble it is (F-69).
